Class StandardServletEnvironment

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.core.env.AbstractEnvironment
org.springframework.core.env.StandardEnvironment
org.springframework.web.context.support.StandardServletEnvironment
All Implemented Interfaces:
ConfigurableEnvironment, ConfigurablePropertyResolver, Environment, PropertyResolver, ConfigurableWebEnvironment
public class StandardServletEnvironment extends StandardEnvironment implements ConfigurableWebEnvironment
Environment implementation to be used by Servlet-based web applications. All web-related (servlet-based) ApplicationContext classes initialize an instance by default.

提供 `ServletConfig`、`ServletContext` 以及基于 JNDI 的PropertySource实例。有关详细信息，请参阅customizePropertySources(MutablePropertySources)方法文档。

Since:
3.1
Author:
Chris Beams，Juergen Hoeller

  • Method Details

    • customizePropertySources

      protected void customizePropertySources(MutablePropertySources propertySources)
      Customize the set of property sources with those contributed by superclasses as well as those appropriate for standard servlet-based environments:
      • "servletConfigInitParams"
      • "servletContextInitParams"
      • "jndiProperties"

      `"servletConfigInitParams"` 中存在的属性将优先于 `"servletContextInitParams"` 中的属性，而在上述任一位置找到的属性均优先于 `"jndiProperties"` 中找到的属性。

      上述任何属性都将优先于由 `StandardEnvironment` 超类提供的系统属性和环境变量。

      `Servlet` 相关的属性源在此阶段被添加为 `stubs`，一旦实际的 `ServletContext` 对象可用，它们将被完全初始化。

      添加 `"jndiProperties"` 的功能可以通过设置`JndiLocatorDelegate.IGNORE_JNDI_PROPERTY_NAME`来禁用。

      Overrides:
      `StandardEnvironment` 类中的 customizePropertySources
